title: High-Level Design

node_notes.standby: PC9 drives the STSPIN830 standby control through the X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 GPIO_STBY callback. The binding is APP_MOTOR_STBY_GPIO_PORT and APP_MOTOR_STBY_GPIO_PIN in app_config.h, with writes implemented by HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.phase_v: PA9 is the motor phase V PWM output and is configured as GPIO_AF6_TIM1. app_config.h names it APP_MOTOR_PHASE_V_GPIO_PORT and the board adapter maps it to TIM1 channel 2.
node_notes.phase_u: PA8 is the motor phase U PWM output and is configured as GPIO_AF6_TIM1. app_config.h names it APP_MOTOR_PHASE_U_GPIO_PORT and firmware/platforms/stm32/stm32_motor_board.c assigns it to TIM1 channel 1.
node_notes.driver: The X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 driver exposes motor drive, standby, fault, and PWM callback operations for the STSPIN830 board. firmware/platforms/stm32/stm32_motor_board.c initializes it with three PWM inputs and callback functions implemented over TIM1 and GPIO.
node_notes.tim1: TIM1 generates the three PWM channels used for the motor phases at the configured 20 kHz motor PWM frequency. stm32_motor_board.c configures TIM1 and uses HAL_TIM_PWM_Start and compare-register updates for channels 1 through 3.
node_notes.console: This is the real serial sink for startup, status, command responses, and LOG macros. uart_if_write reaches HAL_UART_Transmit in uart_stm32.c, while logger.h maps LOGI and LOGE to printf output routed by the platform.
node_notes.usart2: USART2 provides the command and response transport with transmit on PA2 and receive on PA3 at 115200 baud. firmware/platforms/stm32/uart_stm32.c configures GPIO_AF7_USART2, uses interrupt reception, and transmits through HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.led: PA5 is the NUCLEO-G431RB user status LED and is toggled from the main loop. app_config.h identifies APP_LED_GPIO_PORT and APP_LED_GPIO_PIN, and Core/Src/main.c calls HAL_GPIO_TogglePin.
node_notes.lifecycle: This module tracks stopped, starting, running, and fault motor states and ramps electrical frequency. firmware/services/motor_lifecycle/motor_lifecycle.c calls motor_waveform_step during motor_lifecycle_process.
node_notes.board: This STM32 adapter binds the portable motor-board interface to HAL GPIO, TIM1 PWM, and the X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 driver. firmware/platforms/stm32/stm32_motor_board.c implements motor_board_prepare, motor_board_apply_pwm, motor_board_read_fault, and motor_board_shutdown.
node_notes.waveform: This module converts electrical angle, frequency, amplitude, and direction into three U/V/W duty values. firmware/modules/motor_waveform/motor_waveform.c implements motor_waveform_step with three phase-shifted sine calculations.
node_notes.phase_w: PA10 is the motor phase W PWM output and is configured as GPIO_AF6_TIM1. app_config.h names it APP_MOTOR_PHASE_W_GPIO_PORT and the board adapter maps it to TIM1 channel 3.
node_notes.fault: PB12 is the enable/fault input read by the motor-board adapter with an internal pull-up. stm32_motor_board.c uses HAL_GPIO_ReadPin on APP_MOTOR_EN_FAULT_GPIO_PORT and APP_MOTOR_EN_FAULT_GPIO_PIN and converts the active-low level using APP_MOTOR_FAULT_ACTIVE_LEVEL.
node_notes.main: This is the STM32 entry path that initializes HAL, probes USART2, calls app_start, and repeatedly calls app_process. The evidence is Core/Src/main.c, including HAL_GPIO_TogglePin on the PA5 LED and HAL_Delay using APP_LED_PERIOD_MS.
node_notes.app: This application owns UART command processing, motor lifecycle calls, status reporting, and logging. firmware/app/app.c provides app_start, app_process, process_uart, and dispatch_command, and sends responses through uart_if_write.
